node.title: Re^3: Replace a Hex Value in Column
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
But I am dealing with piped traffic so STDIN will be the input and lines should be written one by one

STDIN and STDOUT are filehandles, like $ifh and $ofh in my code. Here, I'm using [doc://select] to get STDOUT and [doc://perlvar#ARGV] to get Perl's magic command-line argument filehandle, which reads from STDIN when no files are specified on the command line. I've assumed you don't want some of the binary data from [id://1208380|here], but note that this still doesn't strip all of it out.

use warnings; use strict; use Text::CSV; # also install Text::CSV_XS for speed my $csv = Text::CSV->new({ binary=>1, auto_diag=>2, escape_char=>'\\', eol=>$/, quote_char=>'"', sep_char=>";", always_quote=>1 }); while ( my $row = $csv->getline(*ARGV) ) { $row->[5] = pack '(H2)*', split /:/, $row->[5]; $row->[5] =~ s/\A\x19\x68\x09\x24\x00+|\x00+\z//g; $csv->print(select, $row); } $csv->eof or $csv->error_diag;
